Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly stated that Giuliano Carnimeo died in 1974. This is a factual error; the WebSurfer had just confirmed in the previous turn that Giuliano Carnimeo died in 2016. The year 1974 is the release year of the film "Poker in Bed," not the director's death year. Consequently, the Planner drew the wrong conclusion that Carnimeo died earlier than Rossellini (1977) based on this false data point, whereas the correct conclusion is that Rossellini died earlier (1977 vs 2016).
